book.name: 2 Qorontoosa Kiita
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoosa Asaas Xaafida Nam7antho Kiita

content: Ha77i nu de7iya dunkaane daaniya ha sa7a asatethay laaletikoka, asi keexiboonna, Xoossay keexida merinaa keethay nuus salon de7eysa eroos.
Salo asatethaa ma7anaw amotishe ha77i ha sa7an de7ishe oolos.
Nuuni hessa ma7iya wode kallotoko.
Dunkaane daaniya ha sa7a asatethan nu de7ishe deexetidi oolos. Hayqiya nu asatethay de7on laametana mela salo asatethaa ma7anaw koyoosipe attishin, ashuwape shaaketanaw koyidi gidenna.
Nuna haysas giigisiday Xoossaa. Qassi sinthafe yaanabas oythi oothidi ba Ayyaana nuus immis.
Hessa gisho, nuuni ha sa7a asatethan de7iya wode ubban Godaape haakidi de7eysa erikoka ubba wode ammanetidi de7oos.
Nuuni de7ey ammanonape attishin, be7iyaban gidenna.
Nu ha sa7a asatethafe shaaketidi, nu soo bidi Godaara issife daanaw amotiya gisho, ammanetidi de7oos.
Hessa gisho, nu ha asatethan de7in woyko ha asatethafe shaaketin, nu amoy iya ufaysanaysa.
Nuuni issoy issoy ha sa7an de7ishe lo77o gidin woyko iita gidin, oothida oosuwas bessiya pirdaa ekanaw Kiristoosa pirda araata sinthan shiiqana.
Ase Xoossara Sigetho
Hiza, Godaa yashshi ay guusseko nuuni eriya gisho, asay nu odeysa ekana mela zoroos. Xoossay, nuuni ooneko nuna erees; qassi hinteka hinte kahan nu ooneko ereeta yaagada qopayis.
Wozanan gidonashin, malan ceeqetiya asaa doona oythanaw hinte nunan ceeqetana mela hintew gaaso gidanaw koyoosipe attishin, nu nuna zaaridi nashshanaw koyoko.
Nu gooshshi gidiko Xoossa bonchosa; wozanaama gidiko hintesa.
Issoy ubbaas hayqidaysanne ubbay qassi iyara hayqidaysa nu eriya gisho, Kiristoosa siiqoy nuna haarees.
De7on de7eysati hizape guye bantaw gidonashin, entaw hayqidaysasinne hayqope dendidaysas daana mela Kiristoosi asa ubbaa gisho hayqis.
Hizape guye, nuuni oonaka asa qofan pirdoko. Haysafe kase nuuni Kiristoosaka asa qofan be7idaba gidikoka, hizape hessada be7oko.
Hessa gisho, oonika Kiristoosan de7iko ooratha medhetethi; gal7a medhetethay aadhis; ubbayka oorathi gidis.
Hessa ubbaa Xoossay oothis. I Kiristoosa baggara nuna baara sigethis. Qassi harata baara sigethana mela nuus sigetho ooso immis.
Xoossay Kiristoosa baggara asa ubbaa baara sigethees. Enta nagaraa taybibeenna; qassi asaa baara sigethiya qaala nuus immis.
Xoossay asaa nu baggara xeegiya gisho, nu Kiristoosan kiitetidi asaa Xoossara sigetite gidi Kiristoosa gisho, woossoos.
Nuuni Xoossaa xillotethaa Kiristoosa baggara ekana mela, nagara eronna Kiristoosa nu gisho, nagarancho asada oothis.
